end.summary:
Position words practised: top/bottom, inside/outside, near/far.
Inside/outside for containers is still building; 2 of 5 unaided responses were correct.
Near/far with a reference thing was partly practised; 2 of 5 unaided responses were correct.
“On top of” and “inside” remained mixed up; near/far was not yet consistently compared with another thing.
end.parentNote: Asha practised inside/outside and near/far using objects and comparisons. Shaurya used “andar” correctly in some container examples, including the ball and laddoo, while the top/inside mix-up was still present later; near/far also needs more practice as a comparison between two things. At home, place a toy inside a box, on top of it, near one object, and far from another, then ask Shaurya to say the position.
